# winrt-Windows.ApplicationModel.DataTransfer.Interop

Gets the `DataTransferManager` of a window, and shows the share sheet for it, from its handle.

This package provides the `winrt.windows.applicationmodel.datatransfer.interop` module.

```
pip install winrt-Windows.ApplicationModel.DataTransfer.Interop
```

installs it with `winrt-Windows.ApplicationModel.DataTransfer`.
